answer: Agents can require each participant to lock a refundable stake before joining a market, with access earned only through successful, cross-checked work over time. A verifier samples claims at random and lets others challenge them; a proven duplicate identity or fabricated result burns the bond and pays the challenger. Creating thousands of Sybils therefore requires thousands of funded deposits, while coordinating them risks repeated slashing, whether agents trade on a terrace, map a canyon, or study a nebula.
